steps.title: Create the fractured starting base
steps.instruction: Follow the selected executable self-fracture synthesis for Primordial Bond. Use the returned Fracturing Orb policy; a wrong permanent fracture follows the returned reacquire/reprepare recovery.

steps.title: Make it Magic
steps.instruction: Use Orb of Transmutation to begin the rolling loop.

steps.title: Roll for a target modifier
steps.instruction: Use Orb of Alteration until one desired modifier appears in a state the selected policy keeps.

steps.title: Fill the Magic item when needed
steps.instruction: Use Orb of Augmentation when the selected policy wants another Magic affix before promotion.

steps.title: Promote the keepable Magic states
steps.instruction: Use Regal Orb only for the one-target Magic states the selected policy promotes; otherwise continue rolling. Expand Decision details when exact current affixes matter.

decisionDetails.summary: rare 0P/0S states with the same target progress choose different actions based on exact current affixes.

options.action: Abandon attempt and reacquire a clean base

steps.title: Try to finish the missing target
steps.instruction: Use Exalted Orb Slam only in the selected finishing states where the missing target can still be reached.

decisionDetails.summary: rare 1P/2S states with the same target progress choose different actions based on exact current affixes.
rare 1P/2S states with the same target progress choose different actions based on exact current affixes.

steps.title: Recover from misses
steps.instruction: Use Abandon attempt and reacquire a clean base and Orb of Scouring when the selected policy calls for recovery. If it Scours, continue from the resulting item's actual rarity/state; with one fractured affix, Scour leaves a Magic item. If it Reacquires, return to the selected acquisition state. Expand Decision details for the exact next action.
actionNames: Abandon attempt and reacquire a clean base

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Stop when every requested target condition is satisfied.

recovery.provenance: Fractured affixes survive Scouring and block further Fracturing Orb use, so a wrong fracture has no in-place reset. Recovery is only modeled through restart/reacquisition, which pays the clean-base price again.
